solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Predict the lock a migration takes — answer key

1. DDL → lockDDL → khoá
   - r1.l: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
   - r2.l: SHARE
   - r3.l: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
   - r4.l: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE
   - r5.l: SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE
   - r6.l: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE
   ACCESS EXCLUSIVE blocks even SELECT — fine for a metadata-only change (ADD COLUMN with a constant default, PostgreSQL 11+), deadly if it scans or rewrites. SHARE blocks writes for the whole index build. SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lets reads AND writes continue: that is why CONCURRENTLY and VALIDATE are the safe halves of a migration.VI: ACCESS EXCLUSIVE chặn cả SELECT — ổn với thay đổi chỉ siêu dữ liệu (ADD COLUMN có mặc định hằng, PostgreSQL 11+), chết người nếu phải quét hay viết lại. SHARE chặn ghi suốt thời gian dựng chỉ mục. SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE cho đọc LẪN ghi tiếp tục: vì thế CONCURRENTLY và VALIDATE là nửa an toàn của một migration.

exercises.title: A migration that can be replayed (the shadow-database bug)
concepts: UNIQUE creates an index with the constraint's name
exercises.problemHtml:
This repository has a migration that applied once and can never be replayed on a shadow database:

ALTER TABLE "post_music" ADD CONSTRAINT "post_music_post_id_key" UNIQUE ("post_id");
CREATE INDEX "post_music_post_id_key" ON "post_music"("post_id");

Write the migration for post_id Int @unique the way it should have been: post_id becomes unique, backed by exactly one index named post_music_post_id_key.

Tables

post (id, title)
post_music (id, post_id → post, track)   -- 2 rows; schema.prisma now says: post_id Int @unique

Requirements

  • Either CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "post_music_post_id_key" ON "post_music"("post_id"); (what Prisma generates) or the UNIQUE constraint alone.
  • Run it twice in your head on an empty database: it must succeed.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Kho mã này có một migration đã áp dụng một lần và không bao giờ phát lại được trên shadow database:

ALTER TABLE "post_music" ADD CONSTRAINT "post_music_post_id_key" UNIQUE ("post_id");
CREATE INDEX "post_music_post_id_key" ON "post_music"("post_id");

Viết migration cho post_id Int @unique theo đúng cách lẽ ra phải viết: post_id thành duy nhất, có đúng một chỉ mục tên post_music_post_id_key phía sau.

Bảng

post (id, title)
post_music (id, post_id → post, track)   -- 2 dòng; schema.prisma giờ ghi: post_id Int @unique

Yêu cầu

  • Hoặc CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "post_music_post_id_key" ON "post_music"("post_id"); (thứ Prisma sinh ra), hoặc chỉ ràng buộc UNIQUE.
  • Hình dung chạy nó trên một CSDL trống: nó phải thành công.

exercises.title: NOT NULL on a big table without a long lock
concepts: SET NOT NULL using a validated CHECK
exercises.problemHtml:
Make orders.note NOT NULL (empty string for the rows that have none) the way you would on a 50-million-row table: (1) SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s' so the migration fails fast instead of queueing everyone behind it; (2) backfill the NULLs; (3) add orders_note_not_null CHECK (note IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, then VALIDATE it (no write-blocking scan); (4) SET NOT NULL — PostgreSQL uses the validated CHECK and skips the scan; (5) drop the now redundant CHECK.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • On production, (2) runs in batches and (3)–(5) are separate short transactions; here they run in one.
  • Order matters: SET NOT NULL before the backfill fails with 23502.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Biến orders.note thành NOT NULL (chuỗi rỗng cho các dòng chưa có) theo cách bạn làm trên bảng 50 triệu dòng: (1) SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '2s' để migration hỏng nhanh thay vì bắt mọi người xếp hàng sau nó; (2) điền các NULL; (3) thêm orders_note_not_null CHECK (note IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, rồi VALIDATE (quét không chặn ghi); (4) SET NOT NULL — PostgreSQL dùng CHECK đã kiểm và bỏ qua việc quét; (5) xoá CHECK giờ đã thừa.

CSDL mẫu: CT Shop mini (dự án lab của khoá, cắt nhỏ)

category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

Yêu cầu

  • Trên production, (2) chạy theo lô và (3)–(5) là các giao dịch ngắn riêng; ở đây chúng chạy trong một.
  • Thứ tự quan trọng: SET NOT NULL trước khi điền sẽ hỏng với 23502.

-- ctshop.sql: sample schema + data of this task (READ ONLY — the grader loads it by itself; editing this tab changes nothing).

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

# migrate dev, migrate deploy, db push — and a failed deploy — answer key

1. Which command runs on production during a deploy?Lệnh nào chạy trên production khi deploy?
   Answer: b) prisma migrate deploy
   deploy applies pending files only: no shadow DB, no generation, no reset.VI: deploy chỉ áp các tệp còn chờ: không shadow DB, không sinh, không reset.

2. What is the shadow database used for?Shadow database dùng để làm gì?
   Answer: c) migrate dev replays every migration there to detect drift
   That is why a non-replayable old migration breaks migrate dev forever after.VI: Đó là lý do một migration cũ không phát lại được làm hỏng migrate dev mãi về sau.

3. A migration failed halfway on deploy (P3009). What do you do first?Một migration hỏng giữa chừng khi deploy (P3009). Bạn làm gì trước?
   Answer: d) read the error and inspect the real schema before deciding anything
   resolve --applied lies to Prisma about a half-applied change; find out what actually ran first (\d, migrate diff --from-url).VI: resolve --applied nói dối Prisma về một thay đổi mới áp nửa chừng; hãy tìm xem cái gì đã thật sự chạy trước (\d, migrate diff --from-url).

4. Why is prisma db push dangerous on production?Vì sao prisma db push nguy hiểm trên production?
   Answer: d) it changes the schema with no migration file, so the history drifts
   After a push, the database and prisma/migrations disagree — the drift every later deploy trips over.VI: Sau một lần push, CSDL và prisma/migrations lệch nhau — thứ lệch mà mọi lần deploy sau vấp phải.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. b) prisma migrate deploy

    deploy applies pending files only: no shadow DB, no generation, no reset.

    VI: deploy chỉ áp các tệp còn chờ: không shadow DB, không sinh, không reset.

  2. c) migrate dev replays every migration there to detect drift

    That is why a non-replayable old migration breaks migrate dev forever after.

    VI: Đó là lý do một migration cũ không phát lại được làm hỏng migrate dev mãi về sau.

  3. d) read the error and inspect the real schema before deciding anything

    resolve --applied lies to Prisma about a half-applied change; find out what actually ran first (\d, migrate diff --from-url).

    VI: resolve --applied nói dối Prisma về một thay đổi mới áp nửa chừng; hãy tìm xem cái gì đã thật sự chạy trước (\d, migrate diff --from-url).

  4. d) it changes the schema with no migration file, so the history drifts

    After a push, the database and prisma/migrations disagree — the drift every later deploy trips over.

    VI: Sau một lần push, CSDL và prisma/migrations lệch nhau — thứ lệch mà mọi lần deploy sau vấp phải.

migrate dev replays every migration there to detect drift
